title: Zid-An Uskos
summary: Zid-An Uskos is an Arcane Enhancement for Tektolyst Artifacts that grants bonus  Heat Damage for Secondary Weapons on Operator and/or Tauron Strike kill, to a max of 250%.

Zid-An Uskos is an Arcane Enhancement for Tektolyst Artifacts that grants bonus  Heat Damage for Secondary Weapons on Operator and/or Tauron Strike kill, to a max of 250%.
